method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); two regulative rules (a direction to produce or provide, s 49; the Independent Review Officer's 30 days, Sch 5 cl 8(4)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: In: ss 25-27 (the District Court instead of the Commission), s 31(5) (proceedings outside the State), ss 38, 40 (assessors, reviewers and mediators not compellable), s 42(3) (comment), s 48 (representation), s 49 (directions, as a regulative rule), s 51 (summonses), s 52(3), s 53, s 54, s 56, s 57, s 58(1), s 59, s 60 (comment), s 64(3)-(4), Sch 3 cll 6-8, Sch 3A cll 5-6, Sch 4 cl 7, Sch 5 cll 1, 7(3), 8, 9. Out: Part 2, Part 4 appointments, the procedural principles with no fact to ask (ss 41-47), and the rest of the machinery; the time limits for applications and appeals, which s 45 leaves to the enabling legislation and the Commission rules. Reasons in NOTES.md.
